channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Region's largest housing association in merger talks to create 120,000-home group
item.description: Bromford Flagship and LiveWest have entered merger talks to create a 120,000-home group with a combined turnover of £900m.

item.title: Unemployment could reach 11-year high in 2026 as firms cut staff and halt recruitment
item.description: Economists expect UK unemployment may climb to an 11-year high in 2026 after the chancellor Rachel Reeve's budget.

item.title: First of its kind event a sell-out success in the city with more dates to follow
item.description: Oliver Lee-Stevens, owner of OP Coffee Co, hosted a sell-out event with a DJ set and 5km social run and is lining up another at his shop in Bank Plain.

item.title: Chippy in city outskirts has been put on the market
item.description: A chippy which is connected to a pub in Poringland is on the market.

item.title: Internationally-significant Iron Age hoard discovered on Norfolk housing site
item.description: A near-complete battle trumpet is among 'remarkable' Iron Age objects discovered on a housing development site in Norfolk.

item.title: More than half of Norfolk businesses to put their prices up this year after budget
item.description: More than half of businesses in Norfolk plan to put their prices up in the next few months due to Rachel Reeves's tax raid in the autumn budget.

item.title: School near city gets go-ahead for classroom extension
item.description: Hemblington Primary School in Blofield has had its plans to extend a classroom at its site approved by Broadland District Council.

item.title: Business activity 'flatlined' last year - falling to lowest levels since the pandemic
item.description: Business activity in Norfolk and Suffolk "flatlined" last year, with turnover, profit and investment at their lowest levels since the pandemic for firms in some parts of East Anglia.

item.title: Charity football match nets fantastic fundraising amount
item.description: A charity football match in support of a woman’s marathon journey has raised £2,200.

item.title: Make 2026 the year you step outside your foodie comfort zone
item.description: Make 2026 the year you step outside your foodie comfort zone.
